title: WebsiteShareConnectRequest
description: website.share-connect-request@1: what a Node presents to open the tunnel for one share (POST /api/v1/shares/:id/tunnel, capability website.share.connect). The Node proves its Network node principal with a client-credentials token whose audience is openvibe.website, and this short-lived, single-use tunnel_token minted by Connect binds the connection to one share. The edge checks both; neither alone opens the route. The token is presented once and never stored, logged or returned.

node_id.description: Must equal the node principal in the Network token; a mismatch is refused and audited.

tunnel_token.description: A short-lived, single-use, share-scoped token minted by Connect. Send it once over TLS; never put it in a URL, log, audit entry or event.

transport.description: The data-plane transport the Node is trying. quic is ALPN ovconnect/1; http2-ws is the 443 fallback when UDP is blocked.

node_version.description: The Node release, for posture and diagnostics; never used for authorization.

region.description: The edge region the Node is dialing; the edge refuses a region it does not serve.
